scientific_limitations: Applies to scalar latin Alexander quandles on elementary abelian prime-field groups, finite coefficient fields of matching characteristic, and primes at least five; not to arbitrary linear Alexander automorphisms or unequal characteristics.
title: Modular idempotents in scalar Alexander quandle algebras
